title: lavandula stoechas var. pseudostoechas
intro: Lavandula stoechas var. pseudostoechas, commonly known as Dwarf Spanish Lavender, is a subspecies of the Lavandula stoechas plant, characterized by its compact growth habit and distinctive 'rabbit ear' shaped flowers. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and stress, promoting relaxation, and aiding in the treatment of insomnia, due to its calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Lavandula stoechas var. pseudostoechas include sedation, anxiolysis, and antispasmodic effects, making it a popular ingredient in aromatherapy and herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of this plant include linalool, linalyl acetate, and beta-caryophyllene, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
